changelog: Say "delete last line" — or "শেষ লাইন মুছে ফেলো" in Bengali — alone while dictating in WhatsApp or Messenger and the last line before the cursor is deleted. Since v10.3 gave the keyboard line breaks, a whole misheard line (often several sentences) had no single voice fix: "delete last sentence" removes only its last sentence, and "clear all" wipes the whole message. The line break stays, so the cursor sits on a fresh empty line ready for the replacement line. Saying the words inside a longer sentence still types them as normal text.
